text:
Good afternoon morning crew,
Late today, our lead trainer recorded a concern about noise levels

Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk focused on quiet, steady movements around every carrier and kennel area. A calm floor helps us protect the animals in our care and keeps handoffs efficient for the ground team and handlers. When speaking near birds, use low voices, avoid sudden gestures, and remind one another that gentle pacing supports safe travel. <<FACT F083>> Please ensure each document is checked before acceptance, and keep any bird case aligned with the review process.

For upcoming bird movements, please give extra attention to early intake checks and carrier readiness. <<FACT F077>> This reminder is important for today’s planning, especially where waiting areas are busy and pets may be unsettled. The safety coordinator will continue to review any hazards and prevention steps, and I ask everyone to report concerns promptly so we can respond with care. If you are supporting a family at the counter, please remain patient, clear, and reassuring throughout the exchange.

Thank you for helping Aurelia Skyways maintain a humane and professional standard across the Companion Animal Travel Desk. Your steady work makes a meaningful difference for animals and travelers alike.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
